description: Header file providing AVX512 helper functions for OFH compression algorithms, including max/min sample calculations, absolute value computations, and BFP exponent determination using AVX512 instructions.

methods.name: find_abs_min_max_values
methods.description: Finds the absolute minimum or maximum 16-bit sample in each of four resource blocks using AVX512, based on the comparator template.

methods.name: calculate_max_abs
methods.description: Calculates the maximum absolute value across 16-bit IQ samples in four resource blocks using AVX512.

methods.name: determine_bfp_exponent
methods.description: Determines the BFP exponent for each of four resource blocks based on maximum absolute values and data width.
